name: Fischer-Tropsch SAF and e-fuels (biomass or CO2 plus H2)
principle: Syngas from biomass gasification, or from hydrogen and CO2 via reverse water-gas shift, is converted to hydrocarbons in Fischer-Tropsch synthesis and upgraded to jet and diesel. FT-SPK was approved under ASTM D7566 Annex A1 in 2009 with a 50% blend limit. INERATEC's 2.5 ktpa plant in Germany began commercial operation in June 2025 and Infinium's 23 ktpa Roadrunner plant in the US began construction in May 2025.
